scope: Descriptive post-run review; two independent studies kept separate. No new hypothesis test or numerical model evaluation.
count_scope: Finite-sample descriptors only; no count variance, MCSE, Gaussian interval or count moment assumption.
effect_scope: Equal-catalogue mean fixed-history total suppression at the true DGP on each realized inhibited history; not a physical causal count reduction.
nuisance_scope: Exploratory summaries of already-selected fit records. Coefficients across different selected kernels are not a common fixed-kernel estimand.

paired_detection.scope: Paired conditional screening-frequency difference; descriptive MCSE, no confidence interval
